page.title: Presets
page.newTitle: Make a new preset from a HandBrake preset or one of yours
page.dropHint: Drop .json files exported from HandBrake anywhere on this page.
page.emptyText: Start from one of HandBrake’s own presets with New, or import yours: in the HandBrake desktop app, Presets → select your preset → Export, then drop the file here or press Import.
page.duplicateTitle: Make a new preset with these settings
page.downloadTitle: Download as a file HandBrake can import
page.foot: Press Edit to change this preset, or edit it in HandBrake and import it again: a preset with the same name replaces this one. Jobs already in the queue keep the settings they were added with.
page.deleteMessage: Delete preset "{name}"? Jobs already in the queue keep their own copy.

json.hint: Every setting of the preset, as HandBrake stores it. Settings the tabs don’t show can be changed here. The name and description always come from the fields above.
json.label: Preset JSON
json.notObject: The preset must be a JSON object ({ … }).

summary.webOptimisedHint: Puts the index at the start of the file, so playback can start while it downloads. MP4 and MOV only.
summary.ipodHint: For 5th-generation iPods. MP4 with H.264 only.
summary.alignAVHint: Adds silence or black frames at the start so that audio and video start at exactly the same time.
summary.metadataHint: Copies the source's title, date, description and similar tags.
summary.inlineParamsHint: Repeats the stream headers before every key frame, for adaptive streaming.
summary.chapterMarkersHint: Keeps the source's chapters, so players can jump between them.

dimensions.cropConservativeHint: Removes only the black bars HandBrake is sure about.
dimensions.cropAutomaticHint: Removes the black bars HandBrake finds.
dimensions.resolutionLimitHint: The largest size of the output: bigger sources are scaled down.
dimensions.anamorphicAutoHint: Keeps the most resolution and stores the shape as a pixel aspect ratio.
dimensions.anamorphicOffHint: Square pixels: the picture is resized to its display shape.
dimensions.optimalSizeHint: Scales to the biggest size that fits the limit. Off: the source size is kept when it fits.
dimensions.upscalingHint: Lets smaller sources be scaled up to the limit.
dimensions.fillHint: Adds bars so the output is exactly the limit's size.

filters.detelecineHint: Undoes 3:2 pulldown (film shown at 29.97 fps). Drops duplicate frames.
filters.interlaceDetectionHint: With a deinterlace filter, only frames found to be interlaced are deinterlaced.
filters.deblockHint: Smooths the blocks of heavily compressed sources.
filters.denoiseHint: Removes grain and noise: smaller files, softer picture.
filters.chromaSmoothHint: Softens colour noise and colour bleeding.
filters.colourspaceHint: Converts the colours to another standard, e.g. HDR (BT.2020) to SDR (BT.709).

video.lowerIsBetter: Lower values give better quality and bigger files.
video.higherIsBetter: Higher values give better quality and bigger files.
video.rfTip: RF 18–22 suits most HD video with x264, 20–24 with x265.
video.multiPassHint: Analyses the video first so the bitrate goes where it is needed. About twice as slow.
video.turboHint: A faster first pass, with almost the same result.
video.advancedHint: Passed to the encoder as they are (x264/x265 option names).
video.hdrMetadataHint: HDR10+ and Dolby Vision data copied from the source.

audio.secondary: Use only the first encoder for secondary audio
audio.secondaryHint: The first source track gets every encoder below; the other tracks get only the first one.
audio.encodersHint: Each selected source track is converted with these encoders, one output track per encoder.
audio.noEncoders: No encoders: the output will have no audio.
audio.autoPassthruHint: With the Auto passthru encoder, source audio in these formats is copied unchanged; anything else is converted with the fallback encoder.
audio.automaticNamesHint: Names tracks after their channels, e.g. “Stereo” or “Surround 5.1”.
audio.passthruHint: The source audio is copied unchanged when it is in this format; otherwise the passthru fallback is used.

subtitles.foreignScanHint: Looks for subtitles that appear only when people speak another language, and adds them as a forced track.
subtitles.foreignSubtitle: Add subtitles when the audio is in a foreign language
subtitles.foreignSubtitleHint: When the audio isn’t in the first language of the list, adds a subtitle track in that language.
subtitles.burnInHint: A burned-in subtitle becomes part of the picture: always visible, can’t be turned off. Only one track can be burned in.
subtitles.burnBDHint: MP4 can’t hold picture-based (DVD and Blu-ray) subtitles: burning them in is the only way to keep them.

languages.none: No languages: only tracks with no language match.
languages.hint: The order matters: the first language is preferred. “Any” matches every language.
